mapper.sql: t.id, t.title, t.bpm, t.musical_key, t.duration_sec, t.plays, t.likes_count, t.comments_count, t.cover, t.blurb, t.spec_json, t.released_at, g.name AS genre_name, a.id AS artist_id, a.nickname AS artist_name, a.handle AS artist_handle, a.avatar_hue AS artist_hue, a.city AS artist_city, a.role AS artist_role, a.verified AS artist_verified, a.followers_count AS artist_followers, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tt.tag ORDER BY tt.tag) FROM track_tag tt WHERE tt.track_id = t.id) AS tags, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM track_like lk WHERE lk.track_id = t.id AND lk.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked
FROM track t JOIN app_user a ON a.id = t.artist_id LEFT JOIN genre g ON g.id = t.genre_id

where.if: AND (t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.blurb LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.update: UPDATE track SET plays = plays + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE track SET likes_count = GREATEST(0, likes_count + #{delta}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO track_like (user_id, track_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{trackId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM track_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND track_id = #{trackId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND track_id = #{trackId}
SELECT likes_count FROM track WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO track (artist_id, title, genre_id, bpm, musical_key, duration_sec, cover, blurb, released_at) VALUES (#{artistId}, #{title}, #{genreId}, #{bpm}, #{musicalKey}, #{durationSec}, #{cover}, #{blurb}, #{releasedAt})
